name: Australia

flag.description: A dark blue field with the Union Jack in the upper hoist, a large white seven-pointed Commonwealth Star below it, and the Southern Cross in the fly as four white seven-pointed stars and one small white five-pointed star.
flag.symbolism: The Union Jack recalls Australia's British heritage and the Southern Cross its place in the southern sky; the Commonwealth Star's seven points stand for the six states plus the territories.

hook: Australia's stars are all white, with a big seven-pointed Commonwealth Star under the Union Jack; New Zealand's four stars are red with white borders and nothing sits under its Union Jack.
trivia: The design came from a 1901 public competition that drew over 32,000 entries; five entrants with near-identical designs shared the prize.
The Commonwealth Star originally had six points; a seventh was added in 1908 to represent the territories.
The Aboriginal flag and the Torres Strait Islander flag were proclaimed official flags of Australia in 1995.
